failure.invariant: Each newly created Kind node has fs.inotify.max_user_instances of at least 256 before E2E images load.
failure.trigger: A Kind node inherits fs.inotify.max_user_instances below 256.
failure.mechanism: The E2E workload exhausts the low instance limit even though max_user_watches is high.
failure.impact: The E2E result is an infrastructure failure instead of evidence about GoAuthy.

root.cause: The first preflight checked max_user_watches, which is a different inotify limit from the observed exhausted max_user_instances limit.
root.detection_gap: The control did not measure the exact kernel setting implicated by the observed failure.

replay.oracle: The same preflight exits 1 one instance below the floor and exits 0 at the floor.
